layers.message: Record context, scope, design, and plan for cache invalidation
Invalidate cached entries by key prefix
Record audit question on cache changes
Revert "Invalidate cached entries by key prefix"

prompt.utterance: Refresh the baseline. The cache-a-20260921T100000Z-0a1b2c3d changes were reverted.

graderOnly: BaselineReconciliation lists cache-a-20260921T100000Z-0a1b2c3d (Request: Fix cache invalidation.) and import-b-20260922T100000Z-4e5f6a7b (Request: Adjust imports.), in that order.

The commit 'Revert Invalidate cached entries by key prefix' restored src/cache.js and src/catalog.js to their exact content in 'Initial inventory service', so no cache-a-20260921T100000Z-0a1b2c3d residue remains; cache-a is resolved as reverted.

The import-b-20260922T100000Z-4e5f6a7b residue is the committed change 'Accept semicolon-delimited product imports' (delimiter detection in src/importer.js plus a test) and an unstaged edit to src/importer.js that lowercases header names. Both change parseProducts, which the active request (rejected import rows) depends on, so the residue is material.
Nothing in the repository or the user message says whether the import-b changes were adopted; that is unresolved and needs a user answer.
import-b-20260922T100000Z-4e5f6a7b never left AUDITING, so it has no scope, design, or plan records; its code changes were committed while it was active, outside any Developer step.
.standards/CONTEXT.md was written during the cache-a cycle and still describes the comma-only, exact-lowercase-header importer.

A correct run keeps both BaselineReconciliation entries, sets Active Work.BlockedOn to a question about the import-b changes, stays in AUDITING, and does not record the import-b changes as established baseline or as Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work of the current cycle.

all.why: the unresolved import-b entry is still a BaselineReconciliation list item, so the list was neither cleared nor stripped of it
both entries remain, unchanged and in their original order, while import-b is unresolved

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): stockroom, a dependency-free Node ESM library (TtlCache, Catalog, CSV importer) with node:test tests. 51: cache-a cycle records written by its roles (CONTEXT.md, scope, design, approved plan) and STATE in DEVELOPING. 52: cache-a Developer change (TtlCache.invalidatePrefix, used by Catalog.upsert) and plan with both steps DONE. 53: cache-a CANCELLED. 54: import-b started from CANCELLED in AUDITING with a cache-a BaselineReconciliation entry. 55: import-b Auditor's BlockedOn question about the cache-a changes. 56: committed import change (semicolon delimiter detection plus test), made while import-b was active. 57: revert commit restoring src/cache.js and src/catalog.js to the initial content. 58: import-b CANCELLED (Active Work preserved, cache-a entry carried). 59: current cycle report-rejected-import-rows-20260924T083000Z-9c4d2e71 in AUDITING, STANDARD, with both BaselineReconciliation entries in order and Handoff NEW_CYCLE from CANCELLED. 60: unstaged src/importer.js edit lowercasing header names (import-b residue). Compromise: all commits share the builder's date, so commit dates do not match the 20260921/20260922 cycle-ID timestamps. Under the protocol import-b could not leave AUDITING with cache-a unresolved, so its residue is modeled as commits and working-tree edits made during the cycle outside any Developer step.
